name: skeleton-block
title: Skeleton Block
description: A single shimmer placeholder rectangle whose highlight sweeps across it on a 2 second loop.
useWhen: Building a custom skeleton layout from individual shimmer rectangles at precise sizes.
Adding one loading placeholder inside another composition.
You need control over size, radius and colors per rectangle.
avoidWhen: You want shimmer and real content to crossfade automatically: use skeleton.
You need a spinning arc loader: use spinner.
The placeholder is a whole card, avatar and lines layout: use skeleton with its layout variable.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Base color
variables.description: Optional CSS color for the block. Empty uses the theme muted color.

variables.label: Highlight color
variables.description: Optional CSS color of the sweeping highlight. Empty mixes the base toward the text color.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
